reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing ensureAccountNotLinked guard used by all provider handlers, but re-writes the local unlink field-clearing instead of extracting it from unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block nulling account_id, bank, balances, sync source and status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: A guard named ensureAccountNotLinked now performs the unlink of another account as a side effect, mixing validation with mutation in the check layer.

scope.why: Only the link parameter type, the six link handlers' guard calls, the guard and a test change.

maintainability.why: The misleading guard name and a second copy of the unlink field list will drift if unlink semantics change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts ensureAccountNotLinked clears the account fields itself instead of reusing the local part of unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied updateAccount field list in link.ts is identical to unlinkAccount's, not disguised.
